data.exact_reserve_text: An overall strengthening of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 0.3m (2013: release of GBP 32.3m) was primarily driven by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third party liability, strengthening of GBP 20.8m (2013: strengthening of GBP 9.2m). This is offset by the favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport GBP 14.8m (2013: release of GBP 32.6m), Fire and other damage to property GBP 3.6m (2013: release of GBP 5.6m) and Pecuniary loss GBP 2.2m (2013: release of GBP 3.3m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall small strengthening of prior years' claims provisions of approximately GBP 0.3m in 2014 (versus a GBP 32.3m release in 2013). The deterioration was driven mainly by adverse development on Public Liability (Third party liability) of GBP 20.8m, partially offset by favourable developments in Marine aviation and transport (GBP 14.8m), Fire and other damage to property (GBP 3.6m) and Pecuniary loss (GBP 2.2m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' 2013 comparative column (574,782 GBP 000). Prior year development taken from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims' note which states 'approximately GBP 0.3m' (explicit but approximate). The note gives line-level movements for Third party liability, Marine aviation and transport, Fire and other damage to property and Pecuniary loss; mapping 'Pecuniary loss' to 'Professional Lines' is an interpretation. Motor gross premium shown as blank/dash in segment table and treated as 0. No claims development triangle was present in the provided pages.
